job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 30%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Responses and Additional Evidence of Capability - 5%; 4. Competitiveness and Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: All four categories and 30/40/5/25%; allow synonymous category descriptions.

reviews.reason: This is an Apple Valley Fire Protection District RFP for OPEB actuarial services, not the SBCERS global custody RFP. Its evaluation factors have no percentage weights, so it does not support the requested criteria or 30/40/5/25% weighting.
quotes: The Apple Valley Fire Protection District is accepting proposals from qualified consultants for Actuarial Services
EVALUATION CRITERIA AVFPD will evaluate the responses and make a recommendation to the AVFPD Board for approval.
1. Understanding of the services required. 2. Quality, clarity, and responsiveness of proposal. 3. Proposed fees.
